## Paulin Hountondji on critique

Paulin Hountondji (1942–2024) approaches critique within Africana Philosophy. African philosophy is a literature of texts by Africans who call their work philosophy—not ethnological reconstruction of a people’s silent Weltanschauung. He coined ‘ethnophilosophy’ for Tempels-style projects and insisted that sage thought is not automatically the thought of all Africans. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets critique most directly—useful for searches such as “paulin hountondji quotes on critique.”
